statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty'); [ -z "$dir" ] && dir=$(pwd); case "$dir" in "$HOME") dir="~";; "$HOME"/*) dir="~${dir#$HOME}";; esac; chroot=""; [ -r /etc/debian_chroot ] && chroot="($(cat /etc/debian_chroot))"; printf '%s\033[01;32m%s@%s\033[00m:\033[01;34m%s\033[00m' "$chroot" "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$dir"
